_note: Ratchet for the conformance gate (pat-mgixk.403). `min_passing` is a
FLOOR, never a target: the suite prints the measured pass count on every
run, and the rule is to raise this number as projects start passing and
never to lower it without an operator note saying why.
It starts at 0 because the gate is being introduced against a runtime the
2026-10-30 port audit measured at 93 unwired and 19 stub features — the
honest floor is 'no project is yet required to pass'. The first verified
run of `conformance_gate_ratchet` prints the real count; set it here.
`expected_failing` is the other half of the ratchet: a project listed
here MUST fail, so the gate is proven able to see an unwired feature
rather than passing everything vacuously. `timer_queue_free` is listed
because Godot's capture records a `hidden` signal on the Label when the
Button's `pressed` connection calls Label.hide, and the only matches for
and a test comment — Patina has no such signal to emit, so the project
cannot pass. When a listed project does start passing, that is progress:
remove it from this list and raise `min_passing`.
